$comment: MongoDB Search (full-text) index for the `chunks` collection.
Powers the keyword half of hybrid search and the snippet highlighting shown in
the web UI. Applied as code by `npm run db:indexes` — see chunks.vector.json.
`dynamic: false` is deliberate: indexing the 1024-float `embedding` array as
text would be a large, useless waste of index space.
`domainPath` is the materialised ancestor chain of `domain` (see
chunks.vector.json) — token-equals against it gives a domain filter prefix
semantics. Its normalizer is deliberately `none`, unlike tags/sourceId:
